title: One person, two blocks
hook: Two 30-minute jobs on separate rows from minute 0, one person.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that one person can do one block at a time, so overlapping tasks for the same person end later than the plan shows

misconception: Two tasks drawn on separate rows of a plan can run at the same time.
objective: Detect simultaneous bookings for one constrained resource.
